correctness.rationale: For fixed M, strict positivity of every append probability makes the shift chain irreducible, and its zero-state loop makes it aperiodic. Extending the initial Pólya block by one draw and dropping its first coordinate preserves the law by exchangeability. An independent analytic variance check uses f(H)=Z_M−ρ and the Poisson solution g(H)=∑_{j<M}jδ(Z_j−ρ)+(1+Mδ)(Z_M−ρ): substituting the append mean gives (I−P)g=f, including M=1. Within the stationary block the distinct-coordinate covariance is vδ/(1+δ), from the Pólya two-draw law. Hence 2〈f,g〉−v gives exactly vD_M. In the frozen argument the bounded innovations have predictable variation converging uniformly after division by N, by the ergodic theorem and monotonicity, so the martingale functional CLT applies. Lag shifting in the edge-weighted sum costs O_M(N) uniformly in the edge horizon, and division by N^(3/2) makes this negligible. Summation by parts maps a draw partial-sum path x to tx(t)−∫_0^t x(s)ds at continuous limits; applied to Brownian motion this is ∫_0^t s dB_s. The covariance is therefore vD_M min(s,t)^3/3; dividing by the asymptotic N²/2 edge denominator gives the stated density variance. Ergodicity and the conditional Bernoulli law respectively give the finite-memory deterministic density limit and the infinite-memory Beta limit. The monotonicity and quadratic growth of D_M follow from its formula, without asserting a joint M,N limit.
residual_risks: Fixed M, positive δ, interior ρ and the unconditioned stationary model are essential to the audited scope. The recorded finite checks cannot prove functional convergence.
